Find the largest and smallest element of a list without using built-in functions.

Supplied answer
nums = [22, 43, 24, 55, 7]
largest = smallest = nums[0]
for num in nums:
    if num > largest:
        largest = num
    if num < smallest:
        smallest = num
print("Largest =", largest, " Smallest =", smallest)
print("Built-in:", max(nums), min(nums))
Note: Start from nums[0], not 0 - otherwise negative lists give a wrong answer.
